historia.texto: Foi uma noite de muito vento e chuva no Morumbi. Logo no começo, o Eddie falou em português que era uma boa noite pra estar junto em São Paulo e mandou carinho pro povo de Paris. Em Love Boat Captain, cantou o verso sobre perder amigos de novo, que as notas da noite ligam aos atentados de Paris. No meio de Lightning Bolt a tempestade voltou e a equipe correu pra baixar os painéis do fundo. O Eddie conferiu se o público estava bem e tocou Elderly Woman sozinho, no violão, enquanto arrumavam o palco. Na volta, mandou: "Okay Mikey, fix this shit". Em Given to Fly, os telões mostraram imagens aéreas da cidade e do estádio. Depois da despedida, chamou a banda de volta pra All Along the Watchtower.
historia.rotuloFonte: Fanviews do fórum oficial do Pearl Jam

fontes.trecho: There was a lot of wind and rain during this show.  The back drops had to be pulled down.
Our translator said the general sentiment of what Ed said was that it was a good night to be around people and in Sâo Paulo and that their love goes out to the people of Paris.
Love Boat Captain (Ed sings the lyric “Lost some friends again today”.  Likely referring to the terrorist attacks in Paris)

Partway through the song it begins to storm again. Touring and local crew rush to pull down the back drops and other things because of the winds.  Ed checks on the crowd to make sure they are all safe.
Elderly Woman Behind The Counter In A Small Town (Ed solo acoustic)
He gets the okay and says, “Okay Mikey, fix this shit.”
Given To Fly (during the song the video screens show aerial footage of Sâo Paulo including the stadium)
(after saying goodbye and thanking São Paulo Ed calls the band back on stage for one more song)
